SV-11500.desc:
h2. Description

*In Tech View, the Total price amount should sit at the right of its column, as in the design.* On staging it sits at the left.

For example,

* a work order's total such as {{$984.79}} starts at the left edge of the Total price column
* the *Total Price* heading is at the left too
* in the design, amounts line up on the right so the dollar figures can be compared down the column

This differs from the design file for Tech View (Claude Design project "Work Orders", board "Work Orders.dc.html").

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin, check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*, and use a browser window 1440 px wide at 100% zoom.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, then click *Tech View* in the display switcher.
# Scroll right to the *Total Price* column of any group.
#* Each amount starts at the left of the column.

*Actual Result:*

* Total Price amounts sit at the left of their column in Tech View.

*Expected Result:*

* As the test expects: *"Step 7: “Waiting On Parts” shows a grey dash* {{(-)}}*, not a blank, and “Total price” sits at the right of its column."*

h2. Screenshots

!C590114-1-total-price-1019.png|width=812,height=594!

h2. Environment

* *Build:* {{v26.40.19-31ad1e1}} on [staging|https://app.staging.shopview.com/workorders] (Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), 19 Oct 2026 (first seen 16 Oct 2026)
* *User:* Admin, browser window 1440 px wide at 100% zoom

h2. Sources

* Design: Claude Design project "Work Orders" (Branko Cicovic), export of 14 Oct 2026, board "Work Orders.dc.html", Tech View Total price cell:
{noformat}text-align: right; color: var(--sv-text-primary); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;">{{ wo.total }}{noformat}
* PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", [Confluence 845185030|https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=845185030], version 64 (16 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 19 Oct 2026, S2-R20 (part):
Tech View’s cells follow the design

* [C590114 Tech View cells show a blue number, a thin progress bar and the advisor's avatar|https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/590114]

SV-11501.desc:
h2. Description

*Hovering the work order count in a Tech View technician group header should open a dark tooltip above the number.* On staging the tooltip opens below the number, over the group's first row.

For example,

* hovering the count "2" in a technician's group header shows "2 work orders"
* the tooltip sits under the number, on top of the first row of that group

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin, check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*, and use a browser window 1440 px wide at 100% zoom.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, then *Tech View* in the display switcher.
# Click the arrow on the *Unassigned* header to close it, so the technician groups come into view.
# Hover the number at the right of any technician's group header that has work orders.
#* "2 work orders" (or the group's count) shows in a grey tooltip.
#* The tooltip opens below the number, over the group's first row.

*Actual Result:*

* The count tooltip opens below the number.

*Expected Result:*

* As the test expects: *"Step 4: a dark tooltip opens above the number and does not cover any column header label."*

h2. Screenshots

!C590117-1-count-tooltip-1019.png|width=962,height=384!

h2. Environment

* *Build:* {{v26.40.19-31ad1e1}} on [staging|https://app.staging.shopview.com/workorders] (Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), 19 Oct 2026 (first seen 16 Oct 2026 on {{v26.40.18-7d85b7d}})
* *User:* Admin, browser window 1440 px wide at 100% zoom

h2. Sources

* Design: Claude Design project "Work Orders" (Branko Cicovic), export of 14 Oct 2026, board "Work Orders.dc.html", Tech View state "tech-group-count-tooltip": hovering a group's count shows the tooltip "4 work orders" above the number, covering no column header. The design's tooltip style:
transform: translate(-50%, -100%); padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: var(sv-radius-md); background: var(--sv-surface-inverse);
* PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", [Confluence 845185030|https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=845185030], version 64 (16 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 19 Oct 2026, S2-R12:
Each group header shows the technician’s name, avatar, and a count of the work orders currently shown in that group, after the filter view and filters are applied, so the count always matches the rows listed.

h2. Test case

* [C590117 Tech View group headers show grip, arrow, avatar, name, pin and count|https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/590117]

comments:
[~accountid:712020:1b27a800-7b5a-43f3-982a-81e7071a4fdb] all valid, thanks Branko. Ruled into [PRD v66|https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=845185030] for Board View and the other view alike:

* Menu and dialog: "Assign lead technician" when the work order has no lead, "Reassign lead technician" when it has one (S3-R14, S4-R4).
* The dialog lists technicians only. Unassigned is gone from it; removing the lead stays the menu's Unassign action or a drag to Unassigned (S4-R12).
* Clicking a technician assigns them at once. No Reassign button; the only button is Cancel. The shift-clearing prompt still shows first when it applies, and clicking the current lead just closes the dialog (S4-R13, S4-R30).
* Toast: the design's toast, "{work order number} assigned to {technician name}" or "{work order number} unassigned", with Undo. It stays 8 seconds and holds while hovered (S4-R5, S4-R16). This replaces the standard toast for these two messages only.
* Undo puts everything back: the previous lead, the card's place in the order, and any shifts the change cleared. If it fails: "Couldn't undo the change. Please try again." (S4-R32).

[~accountid:712020:b2d16ade-9013-4875-8a9d-e255e63e8217] [~accountid:712020:6d590212-5c9b-4135-ae11-277f3826110e] for QA: test against PRD v66 S3-R14, S4-R4, S4-R5, S4-R12, S4-R13, S4-R16, S4-R30 and S4-R32, in both Tech View and Board View.

[~accountid:712020:1b27a800-7b5a-43f3-982a-81e7071a4fdb] [~accountid:712020:6d590212-5c9b-4135-ae11-277f3826110e] Bilal's design-difference sheet is answered; [PRD v68|https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=845185030] follows the design on these:

* Toast wording (S4-R5): "{work order number} moved to Unassigned" after removing the lead, and "{work order number} lead technician set to {technician name}" when the new lead was already on one of its lines; otherwise "{work order number} assigned to {technician name}".
* Duration (S4-R16): 2.6 seconds without Undo, which is what ships Thursday; 5 seconds once the toast carries Undo, as in the design. Held open while hovered.
* After Undo (S4-R32): a toast "Assignment undone", no Undo button on it. Ships with Undo in the next release.
* Locked work orders (S4-N6): "Invoiced · can’t be reassigned" / "Paid · can’t be reassigned" on the disabled actions, the lock icon and the note while dragging.
* No permission (S4-N1): dragging over another technician shows "You don’t have permission to assign technicians" and the drop is refused.

This ticket is now the fast follow for the reassign changes, in both Board View and Tech View (SV-11522 closed as a duplicate of it):

* One-click assign: no Reassign button, clicking a technician assigns them at once; the shift-clearing prompt still shows first when it applies (S4-R13, S4-R30).
* No Unassigned in the lead technician dialog (S4-R12).
* The design's lead-change toast wording (S4-R5, S4-R16).

The "Assign lead technician" label ships Thursday in SV-11570. Undo is SV-11567. Test cases C682422 to C682428 stay with this ticket.

SV-11545.desc:
h2. Description

*On an Invoiced or Paid work order, the short words "Invoiced · can't be reassigned" (or "Paid · can't be reassigned") should show wherever the lead technician can't be changed.* On staging the old long sentence still shows instead.

For example,

* the lock icon next to the work order number shows the hover text {{The lead technician can't be changed once a work order is Invoiced or Paid.}}
* the greyed-out *Reassign lead technician* and *Unassign* items in *More actions* show the tooltip {{The lead technician can't be changed once a work order is Invoiced or Paid.}}
* while the work order is dragged over another technician's column (Board View) or group (Tech View), the note at the top shows the same old sentence
* this is the same on Invoiced and on Paid work orders, so the word "Invoiced" or "Paid" that tells the user why never appears on its own

The blocking itself works: the items are greyed out, the drop is refused and the lead does not change. Only the words are out of date.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin and check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*.
# Open a customer's *Approved* work order with a lead technician and finish it until its status is *Invoiced* (*Finance* tab > *Create Invoice*). Make a second one and take it on to *Paid*.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, click *Board View*, and type the customer's name in *Search*.
# Rest the pointer on the small lock icon next to the Invoiced card's number.
#* Its hover text reads {{The lead technician can't be changed once a work order is Invoiced or Paid.}}
# Hover the Invoiced card, click its *More actions* (three dots), then rest the pointer on *Reassign lead technician*.
#* A tooltip shows {{The lead technician can't be changed once a work order is Invoiced or Paid.}}
# Rest the pointer on *Unassign*.
#* The same sentence shows.
# Press Escape. Drag the Invoiced card over another technician's column and, without letting go, read the note at the top of that column.
#* The note reads {{The lead technician can't be changed once a work order is Invoiced or Paid.}}
# Let go. The card goes back to its technician (correct).
# Repeat steps 4 to 9 with the Paid card, then in *Tech View* on the rows, dragging over another technician's group.
#* Every place shows the same old sentence.

*Actual Result:*

* The lock icon's hover text, every menu tooltip and every drag note on a locked work order read {{The lead technician can't be changed once a work order is Invoiced or Paid.}}

*Expected Result:*

* The PRD says: *"their tooltip reads “Invoiced · can’t be reassigned” or “Paid · can’t be reassigned”, as in the design. The same words are the tooltip on the card’s or row’s lock icon, and the note shown at the top of another technician’s column or group while the work order is dragged over it"*

h2. Screenshots

!C96964-1-menu-tooltip-1019.png|width=1962,height=1084!

!C96964-2-drag-note-board-1019.png|width=1962,height=1084!

!C96964-3-drag-note-tech-1019.png|width=1962,height=1084!

h2. Environment

* *Build:* {{v26.40.19-c850386}} on [staging|https://app.staging.shopview.com/workorders] (Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), 19 Oct 2026
* *Example records:* S2-37502 (Invoiced) and S2-37503 (Paid), customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Locked Lead Tooltip"
* *User:* Admin

h2. Sources

* PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", [Confluence 845185030|https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=845185030], version 68 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 19 Oct 2026, S4-N6:
On an Invoiced or Paid work order the Assign lead technician or Reassign lead technician action (S3-R14) and the Unassign action are disabled, and their tooltip reads “Invoiced · can’t be reassigned” or “Paid · can’t be reassigned”, as in the design. The same words are the tooltip on the card’s or row’s lock icon, and the note shown at the top of another technician’s column or group while the work order is dragged over it, where the drop is refused.
* Same PRD, version history, v68:
S4-N6, S4-N1: locked work orders read “Invoiced · can’t be reassigned” / “Paid · can’t be reassigned” on the disabled actions, the lock icon and the drag note (was “The lead technician can’t be changed once a work order is Invoiced or Paid.”); a user without the permission sees “You don’t have permission to assign technicians” while dragging. v68.

h2. Test case

* [C96964 Invoiced and Paid work orders show why the lead can't be changed|https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/96964]
* [C590121 Design: The More actions button and its menu look as in the design|https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/590121]
* [C97020 The keyboard cannot get around permission or status limits|https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/97020]

SV-11668.desc:
What: on the Work Orders page, the List view's column selector button uses a different icon from Board View and Tech View. Board View ("Fields to display") and Tech View (columns) use the design system's columns icon. List view still uses the older icon. Change the List view button to the same columns icon, at the same size, so all three views match.

Why: the three views share one toolbar, so the same action should look the same in each. The Board View and Tech View column selector is the one we are keeping going forward; List view should match it, not the other way round.

Scope:

# List view's column selector button shows the same columns icon as Board View and Tech View, at the same size.
# Only the icon changes. The button's place in the toolbar, its menu and which columns it offers stay as they are.
# Board View and Tech View are unchanged.

How to check: open Work Orders and switch between List, Board and Tech View. The column selector button shows the same icon in all three, in the same size, and List view's column menu still opens and works as before.

SV-11686.desc:
Found while testing [SV-11588|https://shopview.atlassian.net/browse/SV-11588]

h3. Summary
In Board View and Tech View, the new open-hand pointer (the one you see while hovering over something you can drag) has almost all-black fingers. The top half of the hand looks black instead of white. The closed hand you see while dragging is fine.

h3. Steps to reproduce
Open the QA branch to reproduce the issue: [https://sv11588.qa.shopview.com/workorders]
# Sign in as Admin.
# Above the work order list, on the right, there are three small view icons. Click the middle one ({{Tech View}}).
# Move the mouse pointer (don't click) over the column of six small grey dots at the very left of any row, just before the status label.
# Look at the fingers of the hand pointer that appears. They are almost all black, not white with a black outline:
!01-open-hand-fingers-almost-black-hd.png|width=560,height=431!
# Now press and hold on those dots and drag a little. The closed hand that appears is white with a black outline. That is what the open hand should look like too.

*Fastest way to see it:* open [https://sv11588.qa.shopview.com/workorders], click the middle view icon ({{Tech View}}) and point at the six dots at the start of any row.

h3. Expected behaviour
The open hand is a white hand with a black outline, like the closed hand.
*Where this comes from:* [SV-11588|https://shopview.atlassian.net/browse/SV-11588], the ticket that introduced the new pointers: _"a white hand with a 2px black outline, the same shapes (open hand while hovering, closed hand while dragging), about 32px."_

h3. Current behaviour
At the size the pointer is actually shown, each finger of the open hand has at most one column of white pixels inside it, and the two middle fingers have none, only grey. So the fingers read as black. The same open hand shows everywhere it is used: Board View column headers, Tech View row dots and Tech View technician headers.

||Pointer||What it looks like||
|Open hand (hovering)|Fingers almost all black|
|Closed hand (dragging)|White with a black outline, as expected|

Tested on the QA branch sv11588, build v26.43.0-003b8fb, 22 October 2026.
